description: This file defines a React custom hook `useKeyList` for managing and fetching a list of API keys related to a team within a project. It includes TypeScript interfaces for data structures like Team and KeyResponse, along with logic for fetching data from an external API, handling loading/error states, and providing methods for updating the key list.

methods.name: useKeyList
methods.description: Custom React hook for fetching, managing, and updating a list of API keys, including pagination info and refresh capability.
